facts.fact: NTRA's Araqamy ('My Lines') service, in the My NTRA app, lets users review mobile lines and e-wallets linked to their national identity cards; the document reports it in use, with an NTRA official speaking on 2026-08-17.
An NTRA official stated that about 5 million people signed up to Araqamy in a week, taking users from about 7 million to roughly 12 million.

note: Facts rest on the service's linkage of lines and wallets to national ID cards; the user figure counts users, not verifications.
